Name: Evil Vincent
Author: PlumpyDumpie
Description:
[center]You always thought Vincent was just a harmless kid…
[b]You were wrong.
[/b][/center]
This mod reimagines Vincent as a hilarious and evil presence in Stardew Valley. Behind the innocent smiles, clapback's, and FILTHY READS lies something far more unsettling. With 6 NEW events allowing you to uncover Vincent's change of ways. 

[center][b]EVENTS
[/b][/center]
[center]MUST HAVE KENT AND A MIN OF 1 HEART WITH HIM!

Vincent 1 Heart: Sam's House
Vincent 2 Heart: Cindersnap Forest
Vincent 4 Heart: Museum
Vincent 6 Heart: Town
Vincent 8 Heart: Town
Vincent 10 Heart: Sam's House[/center]

Let me know if there's any other encounters you would like to see Evil Vincent have!

Has not been checked with compatibility with any other mods.
